channel.title: Qwen4-Max — The Marginal Token
channel.description: Changes that affect the cost of buying and running AI.

item.title: AI model releases, 16–22 November 2026
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon’s scheduled increase doubles a long-prompt coding bill. This week also brought metered Qwen4-Max access, GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra, new image and speech options, and downloadable weights.

item.title: Qwen4-Max: launch
item.description: 2026-11-16: Production Qwen4-Max released with metered API access. The separate qwen4-max-preview remains Token Plan only. Source: https://docs.qwencloud.com/changelog/models

item.title: Qwen4-Max Preview retires and its Beijing model ID now bills at standard rates
item.description: Alibaba’s Beijing service now sends calls using the preview ID to Qwen4-Max. Those calls incur the standard Qwen4-Max rate, and the preview discount has ended.
